[[Tin Dao's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Tin Dao Kaineng]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Haiju Lagoon]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Lightning damage|Lightning Dmg]]: 8-13 (Requires 6 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Channeling Magic spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Channeling Magic spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +15
:Energy +3

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elliptical Staff]].
